
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/clklog/p/19596104" title="发布于 2026-02-09 16:35">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">埋点分析一定要先设计事件吗？我们用 ClkLog：SDK 接完就能直接分析</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div data-version="3.0.0" data-hash="268b6e338cc74471346bed51aedf912c">&nbsp;<span data-font-family="等线">在ClkLog的设计中，我们做了一件看起来“很简单”，但在实际项目里非常关键的事情：<strong><span data-font-family="等线">内置了<span data-font-family="等线">开箱即用<span data-font-family="等线">的<span data-font-family="等线">成熟<span data-font-family="等线">用户行为分析模型<span data-font-family="等线">（<span data-font-family="等线">如<span data-font-family="等线">基础<span data-font-family="等线">访问<span data-font-family="等线">、<span data-font-family="等线">访问<span data-font-family="等线">来源<span data-font-family="等线">等<span data-font-family="等线">）<span data-font-family="等线">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></strong></span></div>
<div class="document">
<div class="section">
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">这意味着，在完成SDK接入后，团队不需要先定义大量自定义事件，也不需要反复设计分析口径，就可以直接看到基础分析结果，用于产品和运营决策。</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">这个能力的目标只有一个：<strong><span data-font-family="等线">让埋点分析系统在“接完SDK”之后，真的能马上用起来。</span></strong></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><strong><span data-font-family="等线">为什么「接完<span data-font-family="等线">SDK能马上用」这么重要<span data-font-family="等线">？</span></span></span></strong></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">在实际项目中，大家应该遇到过这样的情况：</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="等线">SDK很快就接好了</span></span></li>
<li class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="等线">数据也确实开始上报了</span></span></li>
<li class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="default"><strong><span data-font-family="等线">但分析系统迟迟没有被真正使用起来</span></strong></span></li>
</ul>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">这不是技术问题，其实是数据分析的门槛。</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">很多分析系统使用的前提是：你已经知道要看什么数据了、知道指标怎么计算了……</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">但真实的业务场景里却是相反的，对于很多刚接触分析的团队来说是<strong><span data-font-family="等线">想先看到数据，在逐步明确怎么继续深入分析。</span></strong></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><strong><span data-font-family="等线">为什么很多埋点系统「有数据，却不好分析」？</span></strong></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">1.一上来就要求做自定义事件</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">为了做一次基础分析，往往需要先做这些事情：</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="等线">梳理完整的埋点规范</span></span></li>
<li class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="等线">定义事件和属性</span></span></li>
<li class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="等线">统一命名和口径</span></span></li>
</ul>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">这对早期或节奏快的团队来说，成本非常高。</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">2.分析模型本身是隐性成本</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">新老访客、忠诚度、留存、漏斗、路径、转化……这些分析并不是“画个图”那么简单，而是：</span></p>
<ul>
<li class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="等线">涉及用户去重规则</span></span></li>
<li class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="等线">涉及时间窗口</span></span></li>
<li class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="等线">涉及事件顺序和条件</span></span></li>
</ul>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">很多团队在真正实现时才发现：</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><strong><span data-font-family="等线">写统计不难，写对、写稳、写得长期可用才难。</span></strong></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><strong><span data-font-family="等线">ClkLog内置分析模型解决的是什么问题？</span></strong></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">正是基于这些实际使用问题，ClkLog 在产品中内置了一套<span data-font-family="等线"><strong>开箱即用的分析模型</strong><span data-font-family="等线">。</span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">核心目标只有一个：</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><strong><span data-font-family="等线">降低“从接入到产生分析价值”的门槛。</span></strong></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><strong><span data-font-family="等线">让团队可以快速验证产品的可行性，也能让运营团队慢慢熟悉产品为下一步深入分析做准备。</span></strong></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">当团队逐步明确需求后，再进行深入分析、二次开发，方向会更明确、成本也更可控。</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><strong><span data-font-family="等线">ClkLog内置了哪些分析能力？</span></strong></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">在完成 SDK 集成后，以下分析能力可以直接使用的：</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><strong>1.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="等线">基础访问分析</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="等线">PV/UV/IP数</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
<li class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="等线">平均访问时长</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
<li class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="等线">跳出率</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
</ul>
<p><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="等线"><img alt="图1" width="605" height="140" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3239098/202602/3239098-20260209163150690-793782903.png" class="lazyload"></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">无需额外事件定义，即可了解整体访问情况。</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><strong>2.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="等线">访客分析</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="等线">新老访客</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
<li class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="等线">地域分析</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
<li class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="等线">来源网站<span data-font-family="等线">/渠道/设备分析</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
</ul>
<p><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="等线"><span data-font-family="等线"><img alt="图2" width="609" height="300" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3239098/202602/3239098-20260209163221473-533947552.png" class="lazyload"></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><img alt="图3" width="600" height="195" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3239098/202602/3239098-20260209163243964-1938827678.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><img alt="图3.5" width="599" height="251" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3239098/202602/3239098-20260209163308815-83441772.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">访客的基础信息可以一目了然。</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><strong>3.&nbsp; <span data-font-family="等线">用户分析</span></strong></p>
<ul>
<li class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="等线">构建用户基本画像</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
<li class="paragraph text-align-type-left"><span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"> <span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="等线">用户忠诚度分析</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></li>
</ul>
<p><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="default"><span data-font-family="等线"><img alt="图4" width="553" height="259" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3239098/202602/3239098-20260209163341710-883404990.png" class="lazyload"></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><img alt="图5" width="552" height="204" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3239098/202602/3239098-20260209163404032-1780508937.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">详细了解每个用户的使用情况。</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">ClkLog通过内置分析模型，希望解决的是：</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><strong><span data-font-family="等线">让团队在完成SDK集成后，就能尽快进入“分析和决策”阶段，而不是被埋点和模型设计拖慢节奏。</span></strong></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span lang="EN-US">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify"><span data-font-family="等线">如果你有兴趣可以来<span data-font-family="等线">gitee<span data-font-family="等线">和<span data-font-family="等线">github<span data-font-family="等线">直接获取ClkLog社区版进行部署集成，<span data-font-family="等线"><strong>快速开启用户分析</strong><span data-font-family="等线">。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p class="paragraph text-align-type-justify">&nbsp;</p>
